mapper.select: SELECT pm.member_id, m.username FROM post_members pm JOIN members m ON pm.member_id = m.id WHERE pm.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY m.username

SELECT p.id, p.board_id, b.name AS board_name, b.color AS board_color, p.title, p.status, p.due_date, p.created_at FROM post_members pm JOIN posts p ON pm.post_id = p.id JOIN boards b ON p.board_id = b.id WHERE pm.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.status IN ('PROGRESS', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_members WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId})
